input.title: Same Gut, Three Places
input.lyrics:
[Intro: vocals start immediately]
[Hook]
Dark brown gunk in my ears, that's my gut breaking down
Dry cracked nose, no matter what, that's my gut breaking down
Crusty eyes every morning, that's my gut breaking down too
Three different problems? Nah, I'll tell you what's true

[Verse 1]
Every morning she'd clean my ears, they'd fill right back
Every day balm on my nose, come back, it's cracked
Every morning wipe the crust like it's one more thing to do
She never connected any of it, and neither did I, it's true
Until the day at the park

[Verse 2]
There was a dog I'd never seen, older than me
Clear eyes, clean ears, nose wet and healthy
I couldn't stop staring, we sniffed hello
He just said, "Kid, I used to look like you, you know"
His owner told my owner, "Mine had all of it too
The ears, the nose, the eyes, I tried everything you do
They're not three different problems, it's one gut breaking down
Showing up in three places, go after the gut and it all calms down"
My owner went quiet, I could tell it clicked

[Verse 3]
Straight home, straight to her phone, I watched her from the floor
Not ear drops, not nose balm, not eye wipes anymore
She was looking for the gut, and she found it, Iron Paws
Probiotics to rebuild the balance that I lost
Chlorella flushed the toxins out my eyes and skin
Chicory root to hold the lining, keep the yeast from winning
She ordered it that night, it was there the next day
Peanut butter flavor, mixed it in, no big display
I finished the bowl before she even put it down

[Bridge]
A few weeks went by, she came to clean my ears
And she stopped, they were clean
Touched my nose, it was wet
Looked in my eyes, no crust left
Sat down next to me, said, "I'm sorry, I didn't know"
I licked her hand, we were good, we were good

[Outro]
Human grade, vet formulated
Three thousand five-star reviews on Amazon
Ten thousand dog owners joined last month alone
You just didn't know what the signs meant
But now you do
Iron Paws, the link is below
Your pup's been waiting on you
[End]
